# Tender Response -- Dnro 58/02.08.01/2026

Visakoivu Oy submits the following response to the invitation to tender.

## Eligibility

Visakoivu holds the electrical contracting rights required for this scope of work, and maintains NMSB 7310, NMSB 74210, NMSB 75310 and NMSB 72230 certification, supporting continuity of service under the framework agreement. Visakoivu's reference project portfolio includes public-sector work meeting the value threshold in Section 3.2.

## Technical

Proposed SLA targets are set out by priority category, with faster response for safety-critical faults. Environmental management arrangements during the works include controlled waste handling and minimisation of disruption to building occupants. Quality control follows documented inspection and testing at each stage. The proposed HVAC maintenance agreement covers scheduled inspection, filter replacement and performance checks across the covered properties.

## Commercial terms

Limitation of liability: capped at the contract value per claim, in line with Visakoivu's professional indemnity cover.

## Submission

The tender will be submitted as a single PDF file, without password protection. Price is quoted in EUR/m2/year, not EUR/month, applied consistently throughout.

## Annex A

Proposed maintenance visit schedule: quarterly scheduled visits per property, with additional visits triggered by fault reports. Waste arising from the works is sorted on site into the municipality's standard categories. A description of Visakoivu's environmental management system is attached.
